Luxurious 3-Bedroom Apartment | Panoramic Burj Khalifa & Downtown Views

Experience elevated living in this spacious 3-bedroom apartment in Downtown Views, offering a perfect blend of modern luxury, comfort, and unmatched location.

Property Details:

Size: 1,891.33 sq. ft
Bedrooms: 3
Bathrooms: 4
Balcony with stunning Burj Khalifa and city skyline views
Fully fitted kitchen with premium appliances
Spacious living and dining area
Built-in wardrobes and ample storage
Floor-to-ceiling windows providing natural light
High-quality finishes throughout

Building Features:

State-of-the-art gym and swimming pool
Children’s play area and dedicated BBQ zones
24-hour security and concierge service
Direct access to Dubai Mall and DIFC
Covered parking and high-speed elevators

Located in the heart of Downtown Dubai, this residence offers urban sophistication and convenience, surrounded by world-class dining, shopping, and entertainment options.

Perfect for families or investors seeking luxury living in one of Dubai’s most prestigious addresses.
